account: Cognoa of Palo Alto, California, developed the Cognoa ASD Diagnosis Aid, machine learning software that combines a caregiver questionnaire, analyst ratings of home videos and a clinician questionnaire. In a prospective, double-blinded study at 14 US sites, 425 children aged 18 to 72 months with a developmental concern completed both the device assessment and a specialist diagnosis between August 2019 and June 2020. FDA reviewers report that the device gave a positive or negative result for 135 children. For those children it had a positive predictive value of 81%, a negative predictive value of 98%, a sensitivity of 98% and a specificity of 79%. The device gave no result for 68% of children. FDA granted the De Novo request on 2 June 2021. The reviewers note that the average age at diagnosis was 2.8 years in the trial, against 4.3 years nationally. Clinicians in the study were blinded to the device output, so it did not change care.
